blockhash-derived modulo result is compared with dieNumber, making the outcome miner/timestamp influenceable

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only meaningful as the input that redirects ownership inside transferOwnership
_areaId is an argument used only to index areas inside startInvasion
_zombieId is the zombie array consumed by startInvasion and its onlyOwnerOf modifier
_teamId is the lookup key that drives awardInvation resolution
starLimit is a constructor-style argument of addArea that is immediately packed into an Area
TeamMemberlimitCount is an argument only used to build the Area struct in addArea
roletype array is an argument only used to build the Area struct in addArea
_totallimitTeamCount is an argument only used to build the Area struct in addArea
name is a display-only argument consumed by addArea
ZOBRevenue is an argument stored into Area and later paid out by awardInvation through the areas state variable
isOpen is an argument only used to build the Area struct in addArea
duration is an argument stored into Area and later read by startInvasion for readyTime
areaId is the sole argument used by closeArea to disable an area
operand a is only meaningful as the left operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers
operand b is only meaningful as the right operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers
teamHash is a startInvasion-local key derived from blockhash, now and zombie DNA
loop counter i exists only to iterate the zombie array inside startInvasion
loop counter a exists only to iterate roletype during startInvasion validation
totalUndeadsTime is accumulated solely to feed the unchecked dieNumber formula
totalStar is accumulated solely to feed the unchecked dieNumber formula
dieNumber is the arithmetic result compared against blockhash randomness in awardInvation
zb is a memory copy of the team zombies used throughout awardInvation
i is the accumulation loop counter of awardInvation over zb
ii is the winning-branch loop counter of awardInvation over the zombies mapping
